name: waypoint-website
description: waypoint-website tooling: 10 wp-site-* agents (page, section, form and test builders plus read-only SEO, accessibility, design, performance and copy reviewers for the prerendered public site, plus a .github maintainer), 11 /wp-* commands, 7 path-scoped rules, 10 skills, and the guard, git-guard and format hooks. The plugin root is this .claude/ folder; the hooks only act inside a waypoint-website checkout.
